name: VARIANT
author: L'Cronx
summary: MIDI-only dual generative 8-step sequencer: two self-mutating sequences with a bit pattern per step, randomizer with seeds, undo/redo and evolve, 16 scales, chain mode, pattern buffer, probability, ratchet and swing. Plays other tracks over its own MIDI port. 128 presets, 3 pages. MPC OS 3.x.
